title: schoenorchis aurea
intro: Schoenorchis aurea, commonly known as the golden orchid, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Schoenorchis aurea include its ability to act as a demulcent, protecting the mucous membranes and reducing irritation, as well as its potential to exhibit neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Schoenorchis aurea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
